column4: All inbound lanes are shut down at Versailles Rd due to a serious collision.  Traffic diverted to the outer loop of Man O War Blvd
The inner loop of Man O War Blvd is shut down at Airport Road.
The outbound left turn lanes from Versailles Road to Man O War Blvd toward the airport are shut down.
